title: Parts Technician - H. Remove an incomplete (in-progress) inspection
preconds: Logged in as Parts Technician. Work Order Lines = View only. A line has an in-progress / not-started (incomplete) inspection.
steps:
1. Log in.
2. Open the line with an incomplete inspection.
3. Look for / click the bin (remove) icon.
4. Confirm removal if prompted.
expected: Step 3: The remove (bin) control is NOT available - removing an incomplete inspection requires WOL Create and Edit (SV-8095 AC3A).
